sections.title: Label component
sections.what: Builds the label text with a small, medium-weight font, and dims it when the linked input is disabled. Overrides are merged in, and the underlying library handles the linking behavior.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps every label consistent and visually tied to its input state.
sections.watch_out: The dimming depends on the input being marked as disabled in a way the style can see.

summary: Builds the standard text label used to name a form input, with a small, medium-weight font and dimming when its input is disabled.
purpose: Gives every form label the same look and links it to its input.
why: Likely reason: a shared label keeps forms consistent and keeps the label-to-input link. The code does not state this directly.
how: It imports the label library, the style helper, and a variant helper. It wraps the label library and applies a fixed style string plus any overrides. It exports the component.
inputs: Label text, the id of the input it names, style overrides, and standard element settings.
outputs: A styled text label. Nothing is stored.
risks: Clicking the label focuses its input only when the id link is set correctly. Changing the shared style affects every label in the app.
debug: If a label does not focus its input, check the id link in the screen code. If the label looks too dim, check the disabled style and the input state.
